author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independently published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

One of the OGs of Self-Published miniature skirmish games in the Post Apocalypse - WASTEMAN is a gonzo-journey into the grimdark old-school sculpts of Nuclear Freaks. Available as a PWYW PDF with all the accoutrements or a Print on Demand physical copy, you can get on the table and take to the wastes with your own kitbases or some incredible charming models from Old School Archive. Let's check it out!

Check out the PWYW Rules, Cards and Expansions  HERE https://www.drivethrurpg.com//product/548017/wasteman-1st-edition?affiliate_id=210041

Miniatures HERE: https://www.oldschoolarchive.com/store/thunderchild

Physical Rulebook HERE: https://www.wargamevault.com//product/487181/wasteman?affiliate_id=210041
